It also provides a HY2.0-4P Grove port and an EXT 2.54-14P expansion bus, allowing for the connection of various sensors and peripherals. The base of the device contains magnets for easy attachment to metal surfaces and is compatible with LEGO hole extensions, making it suitable for quick function prototyping, industrial control, and home automation scenarios. Mobile Robotics Computer Audio and Vision AI Kits Visual ROS Programming Who are the users? Robotic developers - need mobility for project development and testing. Build and run ROS code instantly and wirelessly on your robot for a truly connected experience. Designed to lower barriers for beginners and boost productivity for experts, MiROS is the ultimate tool for ROS developers, saving time, reducing costs, and making innovation easier than ever.
